activate.title: Activate AI
activate.subtitle: Run plant recognition on your own PC.
activate.how: Recognition runs on your PC (NVIDIA card required), not on our servers. Download the worker, launch it, and confirm the connection from this page. The app then identifies your plants through your own GPU.
activate.statusHint: Download the worker, launch it on your PC and keep it running.
activate.downloadHint: A ready-to-run folder (Docker and an NVIDIA card required). Unzip it, then double-click the start script.
activate.connectHint: On first launch the worker opens a page to confirm the connection — no code to copy. Your machine will appear below once connected.
activate.error: That didn't work. Please try again.

pair.title: Connect this device
pair.prompt: A device is asking to enable AI on your account:
pair.warning: Only approve if this code is showing on YOUR PC. This worker will be able to process your plant photos.
pair.approved: Done! Your PC is connected. You can head back to the app.
pair.notFound: No valid connection request for this code. The worker generates a new one automatically — try again with the new link.
pair.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
